description: Renders an exact Network Planning comparison map without recalculating business results.
responsibilities: Resolve only exact network_comparison_map.v1 and geojson.v1 resource names through the planner-owned render preparation tool.
Pass the returned GeoJSON reference, layers and bounded extensions unchanged to map_utils.create_map_card.
Return exactly one map.v3 artifact and preserve the planner evidence references.
risks: A rendered map reflects the supplied planner evidence and does not independently validate the optimization.
Changing a layer or source reference can misrepresent the comparison.
